title: Jeremiah Buys a Field in Anathoth
description: While Jerusalem is under siege, the prophet Jeremiah buys a field from his cousin Hanamel in Anathoth as a sign that the land will one day be restored. The contract is sealed and placed in an earthenware jar as a symbol of God's promise that houses, fields, and vineyards will once again be bought in the land [ref:Jer 32:6-15|Jeremiah 32:6-15].
